verdict: Direct-FE NSGA-II: 498 s per seed (5953 unique FE solves). Surrogate A: 165 s per seed, plus one-time data generation (427 s serial-equivalent) and training (1805 s). Speed-up incl. amortised cost: 0.81x; true-front hypervolume ratio vs direct: 0.651. The surrogate did not pay off in this setting: an elastic frame FE is cheap.
